question: Which of the following diseases is found commonly among workers in underground subways?
solution:
The correct solution is **"Cardiovascular".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the passage, there is a huge chance of **Cardiovascular disease** among **underground workers**.
 
• Researchers' findings were that those working on Stockholm's subway platforms, where PM concentrations were highest, tended to have greater levels of risk markers for **cardiovascular disease** than **ticket agents and train drivers**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There is no **a****bdominal disease **mentioned in the above passage.
 
• **Renal disease** shouldn't occur as a result of **air pollution**, as the speaker is discussing air pollution in the **subway** throughout the whole passage.
 
• **Pulmonary disease** is also not mentioned in the whole passage.
